subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

________ of the two boys turned up the next day.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"neither"** is used to indicate that none of the two boys turned up the next day.
 
• "But" is a conjunction used to introduce a contrasting statement, which is not appropriate here.
 
• "Not" is an adverb and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• "Every" is used with singular nouns to refer to all the individual members of a group, which is not suitable in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Neither** of the two boys turned up the next day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **But:** This option introduces a contrast and is not suitable for the blank.
 
• **Not:** This option is grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• **Every:** This option is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the context.
